name: Sertse Milleriv zhuryt'sya
source:
'If there is a soul in everything that exists, and I am sure that it is, then it can laugh, get angry and cry. I am no longer interested in human tears - I have seen enough of them in my life. But when seemingly inanimate things call to me in a silent voice, my heart is beating so fast that it is about to jump out of my chest.'

Unravel the mystery of unexplained deaths and save those who are not doomed to a permanent finale.

[Translated from [url=https://milkweedless.itch.io/millers-heart-grieves]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“倘若世间万物皆有灵魂——而我对此深信不疑——那么它们便同样懂得欢笑、愤怒与哭泣。我对人类的眼泪早已失去了兴趣，毕竟这辈子我见得实在太多了。可当那些看似毫无生命的器物以无声的话语呼唤我时，我的心脏却狂跳不止，仿佛随时都要从胸腔里蹦出来一般。”

揭开离奇死亡事件背后的重重谜团，去拯救那些尚未注定走向永久终局的人们吧。

[译自[url=https://milkweedless.itch.io/millers-heart-grieves]itch.io[/url]]
